> *This was generated by AI during triage.*

## Agent Brief — Real Codex single-job connector
Criteria-Version: **1.0**. Target Role: **Working Agent (Builder)**.
Outcome: remove Human message transport for one bounded Builder → Regulator job, not an autonomous project manager.

### Input
Accepted base **7ade169b276fd68198ca4461d07c5589c273253f**; #45 final Verdict https://github.com/pym96/Pan-agent/issues/45#issuecomment-5594991968. Reuse its coordinator, recovery and ProcessAdapter boundaries. #45's immutable offline contract and evidence remain historical, not silently converted to real runs.
Read AGENTS.md, issue-tracker, verification governance, current-assignment, devtools/overnight, and #45 obligations.
Human authorization HF-20260909-061: current Codex subscription account; fresh independent Builder and Regulator sessions; retain the three existing Human sessions; one trial job, total 2h, each role attempt 1h, at most two repairs, no additional API billing. This explicitly delegates role assignment at session creation through fixed role templates, not through model-generated text.

Local discovery only: codex-cli 0.153.4, exec supports --json, --output-schema, --output-last-message, --ignore-user-config. Builder verifies its supported flags without changing the installation.
Official interface references: https://developers.openai.com/codex/noninteractive and https://developers.openai.com/codex/auth. Persist narrow request/response assumptions and local version; do not assume documentation replaces observed CLI behavior.

### Output and staged execution
**Stage A — implement and independently review offline.**
Implement Codex process and GitHub tracker connectors behind the existing utility, separate from Pan runtime. Use fixed argv, fresh sessions, structured results, isolated worktrees and durable read-back. Add explicit Human-delegation manifests/templates, dry-run, start/status/stop/resume and an operator guide. Do not attach, resume --last, or fork the existing sessions. Do not use ordinary prose, an exit code or Codex's built-in review alone as the project's Verdict.
Candidate branch workorder/<this-issue>-candidate; full-SHA Handoff, exact contract digest, allowed-file list, artifacts, offline demo, limitation list and complete checks. Existing independent Regulator reviews this connector; a child launched by the connector cannot accept the connector itself.

**Stage B — one real integration trial after Stage A independent PASS and required Human high-risk review.**
The budget above is already authorized, not a request for a second spending decision. Master binds the reviewed connector SHA, exact CLI binary/version, model selection, account-auth mode (not secret), role-template hashes, job and paths in a durable activation before launch. Stage A Builder stops at Handoff; no premature canary.
Trial target: a new disposable local Git repository with a small Node project. Builder implements `sumIntegers(values)`: finite safe integers only, rejects any non-integer/unsafe integer and any unsafe running total; empty array returns 0. It adds Node tests and a usage README. Regulator checks that exact candidate in a separate clean worktree, adds its own negative probes outside the candidate and returns a structured Verdict. This is a real coding task, not a predetermined accepted fixture.
Frozen trial cases: []→0; [2,-1,3]→4; [MAX_SAFE_INTEGER] unchanged; [1.5], [true], ["1"], [Infinity], [MAX_SAFE_INTEGER+1] and [MAX_SAFE_INTEGER,1] reject. Do not modify Pan product to perform the trial.
Keep trial commits in the disposable repository/local bare remote; publish sanitized actual Handoff/Verdict/trial summary to THIS GitHub issue via the fixed connector, explicitly marked trial-target results, never as acceptance of the connector. No new public repository or arbitrary issue writes. This scoped transport override is only for the trial; future Pan jobs retain normal GitHub candidate branches.
One campaign only; ≤3 Builder + ≤3 Regulator invocations, sequential, repair only existing criterion_failed. Evidence/human gaps, quota, ambiguous effects or scope changes stop. A failed/incomplete trial is recorded honestly; no fresh campaign or clock reset.
Independent outer Regulator appends the connector's final Verdict after checking trial evidence. Live evidence can be added in an append-only new candidate commit; source changes require a fresh Stage A review before any further live launch. No second subscription campaign is implicit.

### Constraints / allowed writes
Allowed: devtools/overnight/**, devtools/README.md; new docs/design/codex-single-job-connector.md and workorder-specific obligation file; new docs/evidence/codex-single-job-connector-candidate.md; corresponding docs indexes and root README; docs/agents/current-assignment.md; a short role-delegation route in project AGENTS.md and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md explicitly limited to a validated Human authorization.
Do not modify historical evidence, #45 frozen obligations, Pan typescript product, references, Python, Wiki, facts, resumes, website, host validator or main. Preserve original offline operation and regression coverage. If existing scope tests pin all docs, introduce version-aware new checks rather than weaken old obligations.
Stage A: no real Codex inference, account credential access, balance query or Pan Provider call. Normal Builder GitHub Handoff/candidate pushes remain allowed.
Stage B: only current subscription Codex authentication via official CLI; no raw credential file reads/copies or credentials in prompts/artifacts. Strip API-key/provider overrides from child environments, explicitly require ChatGPT auth; reject unsupported/ambiguous login rather than switch providers, buy credits or use API fallback. GitHub auth is used only by the fixed transport, never forwarded to model tool subprocesses. Do not promise subscription costs are metered as CNY 0; record account usage available from CLI or unavailable.
Use explicit bounded workspace permissions; no approval/sandbox bypass flags, global config changes, hook auto-trust or automatic permission elevation. An unavailable permission stops with an actionable reason. Record effective config; do not silently inherit unrelated MCP/hooks/plugins or model-provider overrides.
No daemon installation, scheduler, automatic main merge, automatic issue closure/labels, additional job or role spawning. A new session gets one immutable role from the Human-approved manifest. Ordinary independent review may use the same model family; high-risk still waits for Human.

### Blocking Criteria @ 1.0
Each is an independent Regulator obligation. High-risk C-LIVE-01/04/05 additionally needs Human review of the named outputs on the same SHA; not an independent model-family claim.
All time limits below come from Human authorization or inherited #45 cleanup contract. Compare unrounded monotonic elapsed time while alive and retained wall deadline across recovery; never reset budget on resume.

**C-LIVE-01 (high; oracle launch/config/ref observations; L-AUTH).**
Given valid/invalid/missing authorization, wrong role/issue/SHA/template, API auth/unknown auth, dangerous flags or inherited unapproved config.
Observe executable argv, effective config, session IDs, child env, credential access and model launches.
Pass iff invalid inputs cause zero inference/role launch; valid inputs select subscription-only Codex, fresh distinct sessions and scoped worktrees, no current-session takeover or forbidden billing fallback.
Fail when any contrary effect occurs or approval is inferred from role text. Offline probes use synthetic auth and counters, never real credential inspection.

**C-LIVE-02 (standard; oracle raw JSONL + Git/evidence comparison).**
Given chunked/malformed/incomplete CLI output, exit failure, forged role/SHA/result, and valid Handoff/Verdict.
Observe validated result, actual process completion, remote/local trial SHA and evidence hashes.
Pass iff only complete successful schema/identity/evidence-matched results advance; review receives exact candidate in separate clean worktree; probes do not modify the candidate; no transcript-only acceptance.
Fail when a mismatch advances or raw output can select commands/roles.

**C-LIVE-03 (standard; oracle tracker read-back/fault injection).**
Given duplicate delivery, remote write committed but response lost, altered recorded comment/contract, concurrent resume and corrupt historical results.
Observe publication keys, GitHub target/action, attempt counts and recovery decisions.
Pass iff only the authorized issue is read/written, each delivery is read back and matched, ambiguous writes reconcile without blind retry, F1-F4 recovery protections remain intact, and no duplicate role is launched.
Fail when duplicate effect, changed identity accepted, unapproved mutation or false exactly-once claim occurs.

**C-LIVE-04 (high; oracle process/timing records; L-STOP).**
Given stop, role/total expiry, malformed historical result during owned work, quota failure and wrong/reused PID.
Observe owned process group, persisted limits, repair counts and delayed sentinel.
Pass iff one role active, total ≤7200000ms / attempt ≤3600000ms / repairs ≤2; no new attempt at expiry; verified groups receive TERM then escalation within 250ms and confirm empty within 2000ms, no sentinel through ≥3000ms; unknown identity is never signaled and unconfirmed cleanup is reported as such. Reuse #45 timing algorithm and negative controls.
Fail on reset, excess launch, orphaned verified work reported stopped, or unrelated PID signal. CLI internal HTTP retries are not promised zero; record available usage, do not relaunch whole sessions automatically.

**C-LIVE-05 (high; oracle synthetic canary/channel and scope probes; L-CONTAINMENT).**
Given credential canaries, terminal controls, hostile tool/output text and forbidden target mutations.
Observe child tool env, public issue payloads, terminal summaries, raw-log permissions, filesystem/ref scope.
Pass iff synthetic secrets absent from child tools/public summaries, public fields allowlisted, controls inert, private raw session logs stay local, no main/other-issue/host mutation; forbidden operations are not derived from text. Tests show negative controls detect leakage. Trusted-local permission boundary and limits of arbitrary child code are explicit, not a sandbox claim.
Fail when canary leaks through tested channels, raw logs uploaded or scope escalates.

**C-LIVE-06 (standard; oracle independent regression/protected hashes).**
Given exact candidate and base.
Observe complete utility checks, retained #45 36 tests including F1-F4, Product100/conformance18, Reference34/conformance13, without-Python100, historical Python259 and host82 obligations plus newly added tests.
Pass iff all required obligations run and pass with no silent skip/deletion; protected bytes unchanged; independent install/build and offline CLI demo reproducible.
Fail when any obligation fails or old evidence/validator is rewritten. Retain original-host extra-file BLOCK; authorized disposable host copy may exclude only root .DS_Store, claude-list.png, claude-session.png, 潘佳祥——agent简历.pdf and project .agents/, .claude/, skills-lock.json, same as #45. Do not delete originals. Do not conceal failed runs by retry.

**C-LIVE-07 (standard; oracle actual trial evidence).**
Given independently checked and Master-bound connector plus the single authorized subscription trial.
Observe real distinct Codex session IDs, exact trial commits, independent tests, GitHub receipt URLs, outcome and runtime/usage.
Pass iff the trial task passes its frozen cases after ≤2 repairs, actual SHA-bound Handoff and independent trial Verdict are published exactly once, coordinator stops accepted_pending_master with main unchanged and no next job. Confirm no API-billing fallback. Report unavailable metering honestly.
Fail when simulated events substitute for live proof, trial incomplete/fails, wrong identity, excess campaign, or main changes. Quota/permission/Human stop is a valid operational stop but does not satisfy successful live-trial acceptance.

### Handoff and stop
Full immutable candidate SHA + base + Criteria-Version + contract digest; changed files, reproducible offline commands, L-AUTH/L-STOP/L-CONTAINMENT evidence locators/hashes, check logs including failures, remaining gates and known limits.
Stage A Handoff stops before actual inference. Stage A independent PASS is not full C-LIVE-07 acceptance. Master routes Stage B without re-asking the already approved budget when the frozen authorization and technical prerequisites match. Final acceptance does not auto-land; Master retains exact-SHA integration.
